questions.prompt: If you want to learn English, you must ___ every day.
questions.explanation_ar: عشان نتعلم إنجليزي لازم نتمرن كل يوم: practice. sleep وplay مش بيعلموا اللغة.
questions.explanation_en: To learn English we must practice every day: practice. sleep and play do not teach the language.

questions.prompt: A ___ is something you want to reach.
questions.explanation_ar: الهدف (goal) هو حاجة عايز توصلها. step خطوة وtry محاولة.
questions.explanation_en: A goal (goal) is something you want to reach. step is خطوة and try is محاولة.

questions.explanation_ar: لما بنكسب بنحتفل: celebrate. cry معناها نعيّط وsleep معناها ننام.
questions.explanation_en: When we win we celebrate: celebrate. cry means نعيّط and sleep means ننام.

questions.explanation_ar: الكلمة العربية (النجاح) معناها success. plan خطة وpractice تدريب.
questions.explanation_en: The Arabic word (النجاح) means success. plan is خطة and practice is تدريب.

questions.explanation_ar: Little by little معناها شوية بشوية، وده معنى step by step. fast معناها بسرعة وnever معناها أبدًا.
questions.explanation_en: Little by little means شوية بشوية, and that is the meaning of step by step. fast means بسرعة and never means أبدًا.

questions.explanation_ar: بنقول متقولش I can't، دايمًا حاول تاني: try again. stop معناها توقف.
questions.explanation_en: We say do not say I can't, always try again: try again. stop means توقف.

questions.prompt: If you work hard, you ___ your dreams.
questions.explanation_ar: لو اشتغلت بجد هتحقق أحلامك: achieve. lose معناها تخسر وforget معناها تنسى.
questions.explanation_en: If you work hard you will achieve your dreams: achieve. lose means تخسر and forget means تنسى.

questions.prompt: Before a big match, the team makes a ___.
questions.explanation_ar: قبل المباراة الكبيرة الفريق بيعمل خطة: plan. party حفلة وcake كيكة.
questions.explanation_en: Before the big match the team makes a plan: plan. party is حفلة and cake is كيكة.

questions.explanation_ar: الكلمة العربية (يحتفل) معناها celebrate. practice يتمرن وtry يحاول.
questions.explanation_en: The Arabic word (يحتفل) means celebrate. practice is يتمرن and try is يحاول.

questions.prompt: I want to ___ a doctor one day.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد want to بنستخدم be: I want to be a doctor. am وis مش بيجوا بعد to.
questions.explanation_en: After want to we use be: I want to be a doctor. am and is do not come after to.

questions.explanation_ar: المثل: Practice makes perfect يعني التمرين بيخلي الواحد ممتاز. perfect معناها ممتاز.
questions.explanation_en: The saying: Practice makes perfect means practice makes you excellent. perfect means ممتاز.

questions.explanation_ar: الكلمة العربية (هدف) معناها goal. plan خطة وstep خطوة.
questions.explanation_en: The Arabic word (هدف) means goal. plan is خطة and step is خطوة.

questions.prompt: First step, then plan, then practice, then ___.
questions.explanation_ar: الترتيب: خطوة ثم خطة ثم تدريب ثم نجاح: success. stop وfear مش نتيجة التدريب.
questions.explanation_en: Correct order: خطوة ثم خطة ثم تدريب ثم نجاح: success. stop وfear مش نتيجة التدريب.

questions.prompt: We ___ our team's success with a party.
questions.explanation_ar: بنحتفل بنجاح فريقنا بحفلة: celebrate. try وplan مش بيتناسبوا مع حفلة.
questions.explanation_en: We celebrate our team's success with a party: celebrate. try and plan do not fit a party.

questions.prompt: If at first you don't succeed, ___ again.
questions.explanation_ar: المثل: If at first you don't succeed, try again. يعني لو فشلت أول مرة حاول تاني.
questions.explanation_en: The saying: If at first you don't succeed, try again. This means if you fail the first time, try again.

questions.explanation_ar: الكلمة العربية (يحاول) معناها tries. plans معناها يخطط، وwins معناها يكسب. ملاحظة: tries صيغة المفرد الغايب، والاختيار مقبول لأن الاختيارات التانية معناها مختلف.
questions.explanation_en: The Arabic word (يحاول) means tries. plans means يخطط, and wins means يكسب. Note: tries is the third person singular form, and the choice is accepted because the other choices have different meanings.

questions.prompt: She ___ English for one hour every day.
questions.explanation_ar: She فاعل مفرد، فالفعل بياخد s: practices. practice من غير s مش مناسبة مع She.
questions.explanation_en: She is a singular subject, so the verb takes s: practices. practice without s does not fit with She.

questions.prompt: A dream without a plan is just a ___.
questions.explanation_ar: المثل: حلم من غير خطة هو مجرد أمنية: wish. goal هدف وsuccess نجاح، وبيحتاجوا خطة.
questions.explanation_en: The saying: a dream without a plan is just a wish: wish. goal is هدف and success is نجاح, and they need a plan.

questions.prompt: Every long road starts with one ___.
questions.explanation_ar: المثل: كل طريق طويل بيبدأ بخطوة واحدة: step. car وparty مش بيتناسبوا مع المعنى.
questions.explanation_en: The saying: every long road starts with one step: step. car and party do not fit the meaning.

questions.explanation_ar: الكلمة العربية (فخورون) معناها proud. scared خايف وbored زهقان.
questions.explanation_en: The Arabic word (فخورون) means proud. scared is خايف and bored is زهقان.

questions.prompt: My ___ is to be a pilot. (هدف)

questions.explanation_en: The Arabic word (هدف) means goal: My goal is to be a pilot.

questions.explanation_ar: بنعمل خطة قبل ما نبدأ: plan.
